label: სიტყვა-დარტყმა
about: The Kinetic Typographer: short lines of type carry the argument, cut on the beat.
brief: The film is words on screen: every scene is a few strong words the voice is saying.
First 2 s: the hook is 2-3 very short lines, the event in plain words.
Many short scenes, each one beat: a point, a pair of sides, a short quote, a step.
Keep every line short (2-4 words); never more than 3 lines in a scene.
Only for light news: no politics, crime or deaths.
The viewer leaves with the story's one line in their head.
pacing: short scenes of about 2.5-4 s, each one beat.
